messages:
rachel_sales: Quick ask from Acme's procurement: they want an "IR one-pager" for the POC binder covering notification cadence and contractual commitments. Need a short slide + a single-line summary.
marco_security: Draft note: we notify affected customers as soon as we confirm impact; typical customer acknowledgement within 24 hours. Legal/regulator timelines follow applicable laws (eg GDPR: 72h). Provide preliminary status updates within ~72 hours and a complete RCA + remediation plan within 30 days for most incidents.
tara_engineering: For technical buyers, we can offer a redacted incident timeline and timestamps (detection, containment start, mitigation applied). Mark as "redacted" in POC artifacts.
sara_legal: Don't put absolute guarantees in public-facing POC decks. Suggest hedged language: "We generally notify affected customers within 24 hours of confirming an incident; exact timing is subject to contract and applicable law." That will avoid a binding promise.
ben_ops: Ops addendum: containment actions typically executed within hours (isolation, traffic reroute, failover to safe model variant), short-term mitigations documented in the timeline, and follow-up cadence (daily status until stabilised, weekly until RCA published). For Dedicated/Private: we can map notification windows to SLAs in contract.
rachel_sales: Nice. Can someone paste (1) a one-slide block and (2) a one-liner I can paste into the slide header?
marco_security: Slide block (POC-friendly):
```
Incident response (POC)
• Customer acknowledgement: typically within 24 hours after confirming impact*
• Regulatory notifications: as required by law (eg GDPR 72 hours)
• Preliminary status update: ~72 hours
• Full RCA & remediation plan: within 30 days (or sooner for severe incidents)
• Escalation path: ops@redwood.com — customer IR contacts integrated for Dedicated/Private
*Exact timing governed by contract and applicable laws
```
sara_legal: One-liner suggestion: "Rapid, transparent incident response — we typically notify affected customers within 24 hours and deliver a full RCA within 30 days (terms apply)."
tara_engineering: Add this footnote for tech appendix: "We can provide a redacted timeline and sanitized logs for POC review; live forensic data not shared without an agreement."
ben_ops: Also note: Dedicated customers can enable webhook notifications to their IR endpoints — add as small footnote on the slide if buyer asks.
ir_bot: IR runbook v4.3 deployed to internal wiki: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/ir — includes notification checklist and sample sanitized timeline template.
rachel_sales: Perfect — I'll update the deck and loop in legal for final wording. Thanks all! :raised_hands:
